landing_pad.semantics: the block immediately following the routine FDE range calls the 0x60d52f0 wrapper (a pthread_mutex_unlock wrapper, FDE 0x60d52f0..0x60d5385) with r15, then _Unwind_Resume with rbx; it runs only on the unwind path, never on the normal path, and the identity of any lock it releases is not claimed

fields.child: +0x18, first child or 0; the child's whole chain is destroyed before the node itself
fields.next: +0x10, next sibling or 0; loaded before the node's own deletes
fields.string_capacity_inline_slot: +0x38, capacity value for a heap string, and the inline slot address itself: the string is inline exactly when its pointer equals this slot's address
fields.untouched: +0x00, +0x08, +0x20 and the string size slot +0x30 are never read or written by this routine

not_claimed: what the trees, nodes, or strings denote
caller semantics beyond the site addresses and the caller FDE ranges
the identity of any lock released by the landing-pad block, or any lock held on the normal path (the normal path acquires none)
behavior on cyclic or dangling structures, where the binary loops or dereferences unchecked; the model raises instead
order: null head returns immediately and destroys nothing

for each node in the +0x10 chain, in order: destroy the node's whole +0x18 child chain first (the first six child-chain levels are unrolled inline; deeper levels go through the self-recursion at 0x5d4d934, which takes the deep node's +0x18 child-chain head)
then dispose the node's string: nothing for an inline string, delete(pointer, capacity + 1) for a heap string
then delete the node itself with size 0x48
then advance to the +0x10 successor loaded before the deletes
net order is post-order: children before parent, siblings in chain order, each node exactly once on a well-formed tree

recursion.rule: the self-recursion at 0x5d4d934 destroys the sibling chain starting at the argument node, so at the deepest unrolled level it destroys the deep node's child chain before that node itself is deleted

routine.name: teardown of a chain of 0x48-byte single-string tree nodes

string_dispose.heap: delete(pointer, capacity + 1), where capacity is read from the node's +0x38 slot
string_dispose.inline: no delete; inline exactly when the +0x28 pointer equals the node's own +0x38 slot address
string_dispose.size_never_read: the string size slot +0x30 is never read
